captions: Your ticket says A052. The board says A047.
8:05 a.m. Plastic chair. The paper is soft from your thumb.
You check the clock. Then your phone. Then the clock.
The old man beside you is whispering. His lips never stop.
Only now, walking to the door, you whisper: “Ya Allah.”
The results were clear. Nothing wrong.
Next morning, you climb before sunrise. Legs burning. Lungs full.
You called Him in the hardship. Now you thank Him in the ease.

post.caption:
47 minutes waiting for your results. Not one word to Allah. 🌙

Ticket A052. The board says A047. You check the clock, your phone, the clock — and only when your number is called do you whisper “Ya Allah.”

“For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.” (94:5)

Before Dhuhr today: two rak'ahs. Just to say thank you.
